description.es: Damas con tres reglamentos (clásicas, españolas e inglesas): contra la compu en cinco niveles con pistas y deshacer, de a dos en la misma pantalla u online con reloj, tablas y revancha. Captura obligatoria, damas voladoras y repaso de la partida.
description.en: Checkers with three rulesets (Classic, Spanish and English): against the computer on five levels with hints and undo, two players on one screen or online with a clock, draws and rematch. Mandatory captures, flying kings and game review.
